item.title: China’s Solar Power Capacity on Course to Surpass Coal This Year
item.description: China’s solar generating capacity is expected to surpass coal for the first time this year, according to the country’s top electricity industry group, marking a milestone in the country’s long-standing effort to build a cleaner power system.

item.title: CGTN: More than a journey: How Spring Festival travel rush reflects a changing China
item.description: The 2026 Spring Festival travel rush begins on February 2 and will run for 40 days, ending on March 13. item.title: Australia Becomes First Major Economy to Hike Rates in 2026
item.description: Australia’s central bank raised its key interest rate Tuesday, the first major monetary authority to hike this year, after judging inflation pressures were persistent enough to warrant renewed restraint.

item.title: Rand Is Undervalued Even After Year-Long Rally, Survey Shows
item.description: South Africa’s rand is undervalued at current levels, according to a survey of investors and economists, who see scope for further currency appreciation as the government’s reform program boosts economic growth.

item.title: Ambani, Adani Group Shares Surge After US-India Trade Deal
item.description: Flagship firms of billionaires Mukesh Ambani and Gautam Adani surged after India and the US announced a much-awaited trade pact, easing months of geopolitical tensions.

item.title: Ukraine Faces Russian Attacks After Pause on Energy Strikes Ends
item.description: Ukraine faced renewed Russian missile and drone strikes on energy infrastructure after a brief moratorium sought by US President Donald Trump expired ahead of a fresh round of peace talks.

item.title: India Exports Poised to Rise as US Slashes Tariffs to 18%
item.description: Indian exporters are set for a boost after the US lowered tariffs on shipments from the country, a move that eased months of uncertainty and triggered a sharp rally in local markets.

item.title: India’s Refiners Seek Clarity on Russian Oil After Trump Deal
item.description: Indian refiners are seeking guidance from New Delhi on the future of Russian purchases after President Donald Trump announced the world’s third-largest oil importer would stop taking Moscow’s crude in exchange for lower trade tariffs.

item.title: Africa Solar Capacity Seen Rising Sixfold After 2025 Record
item.description: Africa recorded its fastest solar growth on record in 2025, driven by a surge in utility-scale projects, and could add more than six times last year’s annual capacity by 2029, according to a new industry report.
